title: Configure ECall Redial Request
description: Backs taf_ecall_SetInitialDialAttempts/SetInitialDialIntervalBetweenDialAttempts via ICallManager::configureECallRedial(RedialConfigType, timeGap). 1:1 port of CallManagerServerImpl::ConfigureECallRedial. config selects which of the two independent redial tables this call sets; timeGap is the millisecond gap before each successive dial attempt (1-10 entries for CALLORIG, 1-2 for CALLDROP, per CallManagerServerImpl's MIN/MAX_REDIAL_CONFIG bounds).
